repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS subscription permissions can deny access to a subject for a particular queue group, including when broader wildcard subscriptions are permitted.

### Problem Description

Queue-qualified deny rules were interpreted inconsistently across subscription admission, message delivery and permission refresh. A broader subscription could receive messages covered by a queue-specific deny, and some existing subscriptions were not revoked as expected. Related parsing inconsistencies also affected publish denies and leafnode import restrictions.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.12.14, v2.14.4 and v2.15.0. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Replace queue-qualified deny entries with subject-only deny entries in the permission configuration, including leafnode deny_imports where applicable. This also denies access to the subject outside the specified queue group, so it is suitable only where that broader restriction is acceptable. Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-9qgw-9q78-p7xv>
 * Credit: Taeyoung Jeong (@ttzero25)
repo.summary: Queue-scoped deny permissions were inconsistently enforced
